rows.int members: struct X { int a; double b; };
rows.virtual base: struct B {}; struct X : virtual B {};
rows.four copy and move deleted: struct X { X() = default; X(const X&) = delete; X(X&&) = delete; X& operator=(const X&) = delete; X& operator=(X&&) = delete; };
rows.only move constructor: struct X { X() = default; X(X&&) = default; X(const X&) = delete; X& operator=(const X&) = delete; X& operator=(X&&) = delete; };
rows.copy deleted, move defaulted: struct X { X() = default; X(const X&) = delete; X(X&&) = default; X& operator=(X&&) = default; };
rows.copy defaulted after declaration: struct X { X() = default; X(const X&); int a; }; X::X(const X&) = default;
rows.user-provided copy: struct X { X() = default; X(const X&) {} };
rows.two copy constructors: struct X { X() = default; X(const X&) = default; X(X&) {} };
rows.member with two copy constructors: struct M { M() = default; M(const M&) = default; M(M&) {} }; struct X { M m; };
rows.member template wins: struct M { M() = default; template <class T> M(T&) {} }; struct N { N() = default; N(N&) = default; }; struct X { X() = default; M m; N n; };
rows.constrained, holds: template <int K> struct C { C() = default; C(const C&) requires (K > 0) = default; C(const C&) {} }; using X = C<1>;
rows.constrained, fails: template <int K> struct C { C() = default; C(const C&) requires (K > 0) = default; C(const C&) {} }; using X = C<0>;
rows.private trivial copy: class X { X(const X&) = default; public: X() = default; int a; };
rows.member with user copy: struct M { M() = default; M(const M&) {} }; struct X { M m; };
rows.virtual function, defaulted destructor: struct X { virtual void f() {} ~X() = default; };
rows.lambda, no capture: inline auto l = [] {}; using X = decltype(l);
rows.lambda, copy capture: inline auto l = [v = 1] { return v; }; using X = decltype(l);
rows.lambda, reference capture: inline int g; inline auto l = [&r = g] { return r; }; using X = decltype(l);
rows.array of class: struct P { int a; }; using X = P[3];
rows.const class: struct P { int a; }; using X = const P;
rows.volatile class: struct P { int a; }; using X = volatile P;
rows.enumeration: enum E { e1 }; using X = E;
rows.pointer to member: struct P { int a; }; using X = int P::*;
rows.union, trivial members: union X { int a; float b; };
rows.union, member with user copy, own copy: struct M { M() = default; M(const M&) {} }; union X { M m; int a; X() : a(0) {} X(const X&) {} };

cols.U default: union U { X x; }; static_assert(requires { new U; });
cols.U copy: union U { X x; }; static_assert(requires (const U& u) { new U(u); });
cols.U move: union U { X x; }; static_assert(requires (U* p) { new U(static_cast<U&&>(*p)); });
cols.U copy assign: union U { X x; }; static_assert(requires (U& a, const U& b) { a = b; });
cols.U move assign: union U { X x; }; static_assert(requires (U& a, U& b) { a = static_cast<U&&>(b); });
cols.U destroy: union U { X x; }; static_assert(requires (U* p) { p->~U(); });
